Frequently asked questions

A few things to know.

How can I book?

Use our booking form, WhatsApp us, or call +91 93531 55620. The shop will confirm availability and your appointment.

What are your prices?

See our Washing Price List for exterior and premium wash prices by vehicle type. Contact us for Interior Detailing, Exterior Polish and Ceramic Coating pricing.

When is the shop open?

Every day, including weekends, from 9 AM to 9 PM.

How can I claim the festival offer?

Select the 20% festival offer in the booking form when booking for Dasara or Deepavali, or mention it when you call.
